notes.title: Laika: Aged Through Blood Update 1.0.3 is live!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41486218/371ee3fbd0292335c7556111380b69bb7976fc05.jpg

Coyote's greetings! 🦊

It's really incredible! Laika has been available for just over 24 hours and we have already received so much feedback from all of you out there! Please keep it coming, as it is highly valuable for us! ❤️

And so we could release the very first update 1.0.3 for Laika: Aged Through Blood today. The update fixes some bugs and also makes some small changes. This is the complete list:

Bug Fixes:
 Fix (Softblock): Player can't get back on the bike after hopping off in certain parkings
 Fix: Camera is off-centered to the right in some areas of the Mines
 Fix: Typos and incorrect button prompts in tutorial boxes
 Fix: Destroying a dragged bomb doesn't roll back the hook
Changes:
 The game now checks for completed steam achievements when the save is loaded
 Lowered default deadzone for right joystick to 0.2
 Added cooldown to UI input to improve navigation
 Updated credits
Have a great time with Laika and her trusted motorbike!
Brainwash Gang

notes.title: Laika's next Stop on the Road to Release: Steam Next Fest: October 2023! 🔥
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41486218/66ee728a7436d8117de3d72b94f75178fd320398.jpg

Happy Monday, friends!

Once again, it's about time for the fabulous Steam Next Fest! Until October 16 hundreds of demos are live here on Steam, connected to hundreds of streams, developer specials, and much more. Exciting times for sure, and you definitely don't want to miss this! ːsteamhappyː

Ha ha, and you guessed it already: Laika: Aged Through Blood is aboard for Steam Next Fest as well! Just scroll down and click the green "Download" button to get your hands on the demo.

And as promised, we updated the demo from the one you might have played already. And that's what's coming with the new demo:
 Performance optimisation
 General improvements
 The save game can be continued on full release
Exactly, once Laika: Aged Through Blood releases on October 19 and you played the demo, you can continue where the demo ended.

We really hope you enjoy playing our demo! If you're having a good time, do us a favor and click on "Follow" as well as on "Add To Your Wishlist" and leave your feedback in the Steam Community Hub. That would really help us a lot. ❤️

And as you are in the western-inspired shooting mood already, you should also take a look at the Soulslinger: Envoy of Death demo. Enjoy!

Happy Steam Next Fest to all of you!
Brainwash Gang
